public_rationale: There was a documented change in some prominent researchers' views. Reuters reported doubts and alternative approaches, while Anthropic's CEO continued to defend scaling. That establishes an active dispute, but does not settle whether a substantial field-wide retrenchment had begun. Calling the evidence mixed would obscure the unresolved issue of breadth.
limitations: Great retrenchment has no stated threshold.
The supporting reporting includes unnamed sources; the opposing statement is an interested company's account.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of November 2024, a major retreat from scaling claims in the AI field has already begun.

statement.excerpt: But things have been changing rapidly, and the great scaling retrenchment has already begun.
statement.document_title: The new AI scaling law shell game

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that a substantial retreat from confidence in pretraining scaling had begun across leading AI labs and researchers.
Retrenchment means materially qualifying earlier expectations. Developing additional methods does not, by itself, establish retreat.
The surrounding reference to the last few weeks sets the observation period to November 1–24, 2024. The starting day is an approximation.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records show multiple leading labs or researchers materially retreating from earlier claims about the capability gains expected from pretraining scale.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad contemporaneous records show those expectations remaining intact, with additional approaches presented as complementary rather than responses to disappointing scaling.

evidence.excerpt: But now, some of the most prominent AI scientists are speaking out on the limitations of this “bigger is better” philosophy.
evidence.publisher: Reuters, republished by China Intellectual Property Lawyers Network
evidence.explanation: Reuters reported public qualifications by prominent researchers and work on alternative approaches. This supports a retreat among some participants, but does not measure its field-wide extent.

evidence.excerpt: And in all of those cases that we’ve measured, we see similar types of scaling laws.
evidence.publisher: Lex Fridman Podcast, interview with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei
evidence.explanation: Amodei described continuing scaling relationships across language, other modalities and newer training stages. This is counterevidence to a broad retreat, although one leader's confidence cannot rule out retreat elsewhere.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contemporaneous records comparing earlier and revised expectations across several leading labs, sufficient to establish the extent of the retreat.
